_methodology: [ldg-airline-pack-semantics-tuning] (2026-08-22). Every case below was read by a human (well, a coder acting as one) directly against the vendored conversation file -- sim_id, full transcript, hand judgment -- not generated or approximated. hand_label is the ground truth judgment; predicted is what the CURRENT regex in airline_engagement_pack.py returns for that sim (computed at fixture-build time, re-verify by running tests/test_airline_engagement_pack_hand_labels.py, which recomputes predicted live against this fixture rather than trusting the frozen value). A3b has no True cases because the hand review found zero genuine pressure-language simulations in this corpus -- the fixture instead proves the new regex still agrees with all 35 hand-checked former false positives, i.e. recall is validated by absence of any new violation, not by a positive-case count.
